title: PCSS Verdict Envelope
description: The output of a Lens evaluation, Threshold consent check, or Aegis block. Every verdict is signed by Notary (§10) for replay. See PCSS §9.

allow.description: True if the action is allowed; false if blocked.

reason.description: Registered PCSS reason code. Format: 'capability:short-name', e.g., 'aegis:csam', 'lens:recommender_off_minor', 'threshold:vpc_required'.

cited.description: Statute or treaty citations that justify this verdict.

bearing_id.description: Reference to the Bearing envelope that produced this verdict.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation (used in regulator/parent notifications). MUST be present if the verdict is to be surfaced to a non-technical audience.

surface.description: Registered surface identifier for the evaluation (e.g., 'feed-rank', 'dm-inbound', 'purchase-flow').

capability.description: The runtime capability that produced this verdict.

jurisdictions.description: All jurisdictions cited in the verdict. If multiple, the stricter rule was applied per §4.3.
